title: Tracy's own https hostname answers with HSTS (max-age one year, no includeSubDomains); customer site hostnames, customer domains and http stands never do
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/hsts.test.mjs
S2: Read the lines for the tests named in expect.
expect: 'Tracy’s own https hostname answers with HSTS' is ok: /login, /auth/me and an unknown path on the TRACY_ORIGIN host carry strict-transport-security: max-age=31536000 (pre-fix: no such header anywhere).
'HSTS never names includeSubDomains or preload' is ok.
'a customer site’s hostname and a customer’s own domain never get HSTS' is ok.
'a laptop stand on http never gets HSTS' is ok.
'an answer relayed straight from fetch (immutable headers) still carries HSTS on Tracy’s host' is ok, and the same relay on a customer hostname is left untouched.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/security-headers.js strictTransportSecurity, mounted first in apps/tracy-web/src/app.js buildApp

evidence: E2E 04/10/2026 J1.4: cowork.tracy.site/login and cowork.tracy.ai/login answered without strict-transport-security.
fence: A middleware keyed on the request hostname equal to the https TRACY_ORIGIN host; any other hostname (customer sites, their own domains) is never touched, so HSTS cannot pin a customer's domain.

tests: Tracy’s own https hostname answers with HSTS
HSTS never names includeSubDomains or preload
a customer site’s hostname and a customer’s own domain never get HSTS
a laptop stand on http never gets HSTS
an answer relayed straight from fetch (immutable headers) still carries HSTS
